portfolio._schema: The file tag agentcase.portfolio.v1: what makes a JSON file a portfolio (a file without it is read as a single case and enveloped).
portfolio.common: The common case: every key of a single case except the entry team. Its process document also holds the organisation (units, every product's team and owning unit, the shared team lines; schema v5). Products inherit it; a whitelisted key can be overridden per product.
portfolio.products: 1 to 50 products, each with its own entry team, sparse overrides, Knowledge Hub subset, wave and offset.
portfolio.waves: Waves: a start month, the products they hold and an optional dependency on another wave.
portfolio.activeProductId: The product the tab edits and shows. Saved with the file (it opens on it) but view state: never undone, never broadcast.
portfolio.hub: Knowledge Hub settings of the portfolio: on / off, the monthly infrastructure cost and how it is allocated to the products.
portfolio.horizonMonths: Portfolio horizon in calendar months (mirrors the Horizon input of the common case, clamped to whole years 1..10).
portfolio.startDate: ISO date of portfolio month 1, empty when unset (calendar labels only; no figure depends on it).
portfolio.rho: Correlation between products in the portfolio Monte Carlo, 0..1; absent = 0 (independent products).
portfolio.maxConcurrentSetups: Transformation-team capacity: at most this many products in setup at once; absent = no limit.

product.id: Safe id (1-64 letters, digits, _ or -): used in object keys, element ids and file names.
product.name: Display name ("Product 1" by default).
product.archived: Archived: kept in the file, left out of the plan and the consolidation.
product.knowledge: Knowledge Hub subset: the hub fields this product sets for itself; an absent field is inherited from the hub.
product.overrides: Sparse overrides of the common case: only the whitelisted keys that differ exist, form fields one by one under dom.
product.waveId: The wave the product is in, or null (unscheduled); always agrees with the wave's product list.
product.offsetMonths: Months after its wave's start at which the product's month 1 falls.

wave.id: Safe id, like a product id.
wave.name: Display name ("Wave 1" by default).
wave.startMonth: The wave's own start month on the portfolio calendar.
wave.productIds: The products of the wave, in board order; a product is in at most one wave.
wave.dependsOn: Optional dependency: the wave starts after another wave reaches a milestone, plus a lag (effective start = the later of the two).

dependency.waveId: The wave this one waits for.
dependency.milestone: What it waits for: that wave's start, or the end of the setup of its last product.
dependency.lagMonths: Whole months added after the milestone.

sharedTeam.allocations: Share of the line per product id, in percent (adding up to at most 100); each product adds FTE × share to its team.
sharedTeam.pins: Artefact ids pinned to the line, applied to every holder's share row; absent = none.
sharedTeam.unit: Unit the line belongs to (a shared-service unit, B10c); absent = the default delivery unit.
sharedTeam.split: "effort": a service line split across products by the effort of the service's activities for each (D-B38); absent = by its fixed shares.

hub.enabled: Knowledge Hub on for the portfolio.
hub.infraMonthly: Monthly hub infrastructure cost, a portfolio cost (never overridden per product).
hub.infraAllocation: How the infrastructure is allocated: per product, or by base FTE.

knowledge.domains: Knowledge domains with their weights (adding up to 100 %).
knowledge.ktLeadMonths: Knowledge-transfer preparation months before the product's month 1.

autosave.tabId: The tab that wrote the record (one record per tab).
autosave.savedAt: ISO time of the save; boot offers a record newer than the open file only.
autosave.label: The customer name, else "Untitled case".
autosave.snapshot: The exact portfolio in the portfolio format (never collapsed to a single case), with its calculation packages.
autosave.history: The undo and redo stacks, so Ctrl+Z survives a reload (restored only for a record of the current schema opened without corrections).
autosave.format: 'portfolio': the history patches address the portfolio; absent (older records): the document is restored, not the history.

broadcast.v: The sender's file schema version: a message from a newer build is ignored.
broadcast.docId: The document id, new at every open: a patch is applied only to the same document.
broadcast.rev: The sender's revision after the change.
broadcast.kind: patch (absent = patch), full (a whole document) or request (ask a tab for its whole document).
broadcast.base: The revision a patch was made on: applied only at that revision, else the tab resyncs.
broadcast.patches: The document patches of one step (view fields filtered out); the inverse for an undo.
broadcast.reason: Why a whole document is sent: load (the sender opened one) or sync (resync of a tab out of step).
broadcast.to: The tab a request or a sync answer is meant for.
broadcast.portfolio: The sender's whole document with its active product (no edit scope, display scope or persona).

view.activeProductId: Which product the tab edits and shows.
view.editScope: Change: all products or this product only (where an edit of a shareable key lands).
view.displayScope: The top-bar View: Portfolio, a Wave or the active product.

commonKeys.PERSONA_APP_SECTIONS: Optional: per persona, which app sections (🎨 Brand & theme) are shown; absent = the catalogue default. Never inside PERSONA_SECTIONS.
commonKeys.PERSONAS: The persona definitions (the persona menu), common to every product.
commonKeys.THEMES: Optional: the user themes of the case (built-in themes are not stored).
commonKeys.ACTIVE_THEME: Optional: the sequence id of the theme in use; absent = the default look.
commonKeys.THEME_SEQ: Optional: the last theme sequence id issued; a high-water mark that undo, redo and remote patches never lower.
commonKeys.currentPersona: Never in the document: written into a file (first key of the case or of common) as the persona the file opens on, lifted out on open.
commonKeys.MODEL: Model-Engine namespaces, incl. MODEL.CASE.discountRate: the discount rate stays common (one NPV basis for the portfolio).
